```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = TRUE,
  message = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE
)

library(tidyverse)
library(broom)
library(rstatix)
```

## 1. Load Data

```{r load-data}
data_file <- "../output_csvs/gemini_3_pro_temp_grade_dist.csv"  # ← edit if needed

raw <- readr::read_csv(data_file, show_col_types = FALSE)

# Drop index column
dat <- raw[, -1]
glimpse(dat)
```

## 2. Reshape for Plotting

```{r long-format}
long_df <- dat %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = everything(),
    names_to = "temperature",
    values_to = "score"
  )

long_df
```

## 3. Summary Stats

```{r summaries}
long_df %>%
  group_by(temperature) %>%
  summarise(
    n    = n(),
    mean = mean(score),
    sd   = sd(score)
  )
```

## 4. Distribution Visualization

```{r boxplot, fig.width=8, fig.height=5}
long_df %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = temperature, y = score, fill = temperature)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.alpha = 0.4) +
  labs(
    title = "Score Distributions by Temperature Setting",
    x = "Temperature",
    y = "Score"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

---

## 5. Mann-Whitney U tests (all pairwise comparisons)

There are 3 temps → 3 pairwise tests:

```{r mann-whitney-tests}
temps <- names(dat)

pairwise_results <- expand.grid(
  temp1 = temps,
  temp2 = temps,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
) %>%
  filter(temp1 < temp2) %>%  # avoid duplicates & self-comparisons
  mutate(
    vec1 = map(temp1, ~dat[[.x]]),
    vec2 = map(temp2, ~dat[[.x]]),
    test = map2(vec1, vec2, ~wilcox.test(.x, .y, exact = FALSE))
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    statistic = map_dbl(test, "statistic"),
    p_value  = map_dbl(test, "p.value"),
    mean_t1  = map_dbl(vec1, ~mean(.x)),
    mean_t2  = map_dbl(vec2, ~mean(.x)),
    mean_diff = mean_t2 - mean_t1,
    pct_change = 100 * mean_diff / mean_t1
  ) %>%
  select(temp1, temp2, statistic, p_value, mean_t1, mean_t2, mean_diff, pct_change)

pairwise_results
```

---

## 6. Multiple Comparison Correction

```{r adjust}
results_adj <- pairwise_results %>%
  mutate(
    p_adj_bonferroni = p.adjust(p_value, method = "bonferroni"),
    p_adj_fdr        = p.adjust(p_value, method = "fdr"),
    significance = case_when(
      p_adj_bonferroni < 0.001 ~ "***",
      p_adj_bonferroni < 0.01  ~ "**",
      p_adj_bonferroni < 0.05  ~ "*",
      TRUE ~ "ns"
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(p_adj_bonferroni)

results_adj
```
